summary: Learn product management fundamentals with roadmaps, discovery, prioritization, and metrics. Train your team today.
lede: Product management training helps product managers turn customer needs and business goals into product direction teams can execute. For product owners and business analysts too, it develops customer discovery, roadmap prioritization, and KPI and OKR design to track progress and inform day-to-day decisions through delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need practical product management fundamentals for discovery, prioritization, delivery coordination, and product reporting.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: no formal product management experience is needed, but you should have basic workplace familiarity with products, customers, or internal service delivery. Comfort with spreadsheets and presentation tools will help you complete the roadmap, prioritization, and KPI exercises. Coding is not required. Advanced topics such as product analytics, A/B testing, and AI-assisted feedback analysis are taught at operational application level, not engineering depth.
